newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC nickel smelter,part of mine stay shut.
newsitem.headline: WMC nickel smelter,part of mine stay shut.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Thursday a portion of its Victor nickel mine in Western Australia would remain closed as an investigation continues into the cause of an accidental explosion that killed one and injured three at the site on Sunday.

Meanwhile, the company's nearby Kalgoorlie nickel smelter, closed on April 6 after part of a furnace roof collapsed, was not scheduled to resume production before early next month, a WMC spokesman said.
"We're sticking to a 30-day time frame," the spokesman said.
